3285c38.summary: Called when the opponent forfeits. It sets the connection status to EnemyForfeit and ends the battle with the player as winner, filling in a ranked match result (Elo, XP, skull counts, minutes played). It then saves the winner, or goes through the normal end sequence if the match is set to count as a loss on disconnect.

The rest of the output is unrelated PlayFab API stubs that the decompiler merged in.
